svg.desc: publish: 6 nodes, 10 connections. 5 jobs of the publish workflow, started by a push of a tag v*, in the order their needs set, imported from GitHub Actions. Nodes: - Push, terminal - Check the tag and the files (ubuntu-latest, 4 steps), step - Build, push, sign and attest (ubuntu-latest, 13 steps), step - Pull the published image and run it (ubuntu-latest, 2 steps), step - Package, push and sign the Helm chart (ubuntu-latest, 8 steps), step - Cut the GitHub Release (ubuntu-latest, 2 steps), step Connections: - Push to Check the tag and the files - Check the tag and the files to Build, push, sign and attest - Build, push, sign and attest to Pull the published image and run it - Check the tag and the files to Package, push and sign the Helm chart - Build, push, sign and attest to Package, push and sign the Helm chart - Pull the published image and run it to Package, push and sign the Helm chart - Check the tag and the files to Cut the GitHub Release - Build, push, sign and attest to Cut the GitHub Release - Pull the published image and run it to Cut the GitHub Release - Package, push and sign the Helm chart to Cut the GitHub Release
